_comment: Minimum safe versions. Any detected version below the 'min' entry is flagged. Update as upstream EOL moves. Dates are YYYY-MM.

node.remediation: Upgrade Node.js to the current LTS (20.x or newer).

nginx.remediation: Upgrade nginx to 1.24+ and re-check config.

php.remediation: Upgrade PHP to a supported 8.x release.
